meta.title: Application name, copied from the PRD.
meta.updated_at: Date this screen artifact was last written (YYYY-MM-DD).

ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.
id: Screen ID matching the entry in screen-index, e.g. 'screen-001--login'.
name: Human-readable screen name, e.g. 'Login'.
module_id: Module ID this screen belongs to, matching module-index.
description: One paragraph describing what this screen is for from a business perspective.
actors: List of actor IDs (from actor-index) who interact with this screen.
entry_points: How does a user reach this screen? List of trigger points or navigation paths (e.g. 'clicking Login from the landing page', 'redirect after session expiry').
information_displayed: What information does this screen show to the user? List of data items or content areas.

available_actions.action: Short name of the action, e.g. 'Submit login form'.
available_actions.description: What happens when this action is performed — from a business perspective only.
available_actions.actor_ids: List of actor IDs (subset of screen actors) who can perform this action.

business_rules: List of business rules, constraints, or policies that apply to this screen. Pure business logic — no technical detail.
usecase_ids: List of usecase IDs (from usecase-index) that are fulfilled on this screen.
edge_cases: Notable edge cases or exceptional situations the business must handle on this screen.
test_priority: Testing priority for this screen: 'high', 'medium', or 'low'. Derived from data sensitivity, number of business rules, actor complexity, and financial/legal impact. Used by Phase 4 to calibrate testing effort per screen.
open_questions: Unresolved business questions that need stakeholder input before Phase 3 can proceed.
